title: 第2127章 坐地起价第2126章 背叛
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，谁能比我极阴更阴！第二卷：玄界第2127章坐地起价！（..la）“主人！此时不动手，更待何时？””影虚喊道。
“主人？”鹰头虚妖眼神错愕，“你叫谁‘主人’？”
它的话刚问出口，就感知到，上方传来浩荡天威。
天威昭昭，如山如岳；带着一股令它灵魂战栗的力量。
鹰头虚妖蓦然抬头，就见：
一道玄黄雷霆，刺破幽幽源炁，直劈而下！
“这是...雷法？”
鹰头虚妖瞳孔骤缩，转身就想往远处遁去。
可是，它岂能逃过雷霆的追击。
眨眼间，那落雷便已逼近。
雷光未至，雷霆之力却已然临身，让它身形瞬间都僵硬了几分。
鹰头虚妖终于自知无处可逃，当即挥动八条触手，朝着落雷猛抽而去。
"轰！"
触手击中落雷的瞬间，落雷陡然炸开，化作万千雷蛇，却并不四散，而是如瀑布一般，将鹰头虚妖全身都笼罩其中。
“叽叽——”
凄厉的嘶鸣声，不断从玄黄色的雷光间传出。
紧接着，鹰头虚妖终于冲破雷光的封锁，逃了出来。
可是，它周身已然变得焦黑，表皮上还分布着一道道狰狞裂口。触手又断了两条，只剩六条。
然而，不待它有任何喘息之机，九条触手如藤蔓般缠绕而来。
乃龙虚藤出手了。

鹰头虚妖根本来不及反应，就被龙虚藤的触手给缠了个结结实实。
但是，对于鹰头虚妖而言，龙虚藤的实力还是差了一些。
鹰头虚妖运转体内源炁，就欲挣断缠绕在它身上的触手。
可就在这时，一抹幽光袭来，直接没入了它的右眼。
“嘭！”
鹰头虚妖的整个头颅，陡然炸开。
虚妖一族，肉身神魂一体。
头颅炸开，鹰头虚妖随之陨落，剩余残躯顿时没了半点动静。当龙虚藤触手将之松开后，便朝着地面直落而下。
“方才属下所为，主人可还满意？”影虚略带谄媚的声音传来。
“你倒是还算识时务。”宋文道。
很显然，影虚刚刚已有了异心，只是最终将之压下了而已。
或许，它也知，一头受伤的一阶仙境后期虚妖，加它这个初入仙境的虚妖，绝非宋文和龙虚藤的对手。
“主人，此地并非久留之地，我们是不是该离开了？”
影虚说着，九条触手卷向鹰头虚妖的残躯。
紧接着，它身形逐渐虚化，连同被它缠绕的鹰头虚妖残躯，一同化作幻影。
幻影掠向宋文，没入了宋文体内。
旋即，影虚便出现在了宋文的识海之中。
“主人，这畜生的残躯，可是好东西，千万别浪费了。”影虚松开了鹰头虚妖残躯。
识海黑洞降下一股吞噬之力，将残躯吞入其中。
宋文又将龙虚藤收入灵兽袋，转身便往远处疾驰而去。

......
三日后。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Among mortals cultivating immortality, who can be more yin than me! Volume 2: Xuanjie Chapter 2127: Raise the price while sitting on the ground! (..la) "Master! If you don't take action now, when will you wait?" Yingxu shouted.
"Master? The eagle-headed virtual demon's eyes were stunned, "Who did you call 'Master'?" "
As soon as the words came out of its mouth, it felt the mighty power of heaven coming from above.
The power of the sky is as clear as a mountain; it carries a power that makes its soul tremble.
The hawk-headed virtual demon suddenly raised its head and saw:
A black and yellow thunderbolt pierced through the faint source of energy and struck straight down!
"This is...Refa? "
The eyes of the eagle-headed virtual demon suddenly shrank, and he turned around and wanted to flee far away.
However, how could it escape the pursuit of Thunder.
In the blink of an eye, the thunder was approaching.
Before the lightning arrived, the power of thunder had already arrived, making its figure instantly stiffen.
The hawk-headed virtual demon finally realized that he had nowhere to escape, and immediately waved his eight tentacles and swung towards Luo Lei.
"Boom! "
The moment the tentacle hit the Thunderbolt, the Thunderbolt suddenly exploded and turned into thousands of thunder snakes. However, they did not scatter in all directions. Instead, they covered the whole body of the eagle-headed virtual demon like a waterfall.
"Jiji——"
The shrill screams kept coming from the black-yellow thunder light.
Immediately afterwards, the hawk-headed virtual demon finally broke through the lightning blockade and escaped.
However, its entire body had become charred black, and there were still vicious cracks on its skin. Two more tentacles were broken off, leaving only six.
However, before it had any chance to breathe, nine tentacles wrapped around it like vines.
Nailong Xuteng took action.
The eagle-headed virtual demon had no time to react before it was tightly entangled by the tentacles of the Dragon Void Vine.
However, for the eagle-headed virtual demon, the strength of Longxu Teng is still a little inferior.
The eagle-headed virtual demon circulates the energy in its body, trying to break the tentacles wrapped around its body.
But at this moment, a wisp of light struck and disappeared directly into its right eye.
“Bang! "
The entire head of the hawk-headed virtual demon suddenly exploded.
The virtual demon clan has body, soul, and body.
The head exploded, and the eagle-headed virtual demon fell. The remaining body suddenly became motionless. When the Longxu Vine's tentacles released it, it fell straight down to the ground.
"Is the master still satisfied with what my subordinates did just now? "Yingxu's slightly flattering voice came.
"You are quite aware of current affairs. " Song Wendao.
Obviously, Yingxu had some dissatisfaction just now, but he finally suppressed it.
Perhaps, it also knew that an injured virtual demon in the late stage of the first-order fairyland, and a virtual demon that had just entered the fairyland, was no match for Song Wen and Longxu Teng.
“Master, this is not a place to stay for a long time, should we leave? "
Yingxu said, and nine tentacles rolled towards the remains of the hawk-headed virtual demon.
Immediately afterwards, its figure gradually disappeared, and together with the remains of the eagle-headed virtual demon wrapped around it, it turned into a phantom.
The phantom flew towards Song Wen and submerged into Song Wen's body.
Immediately, Yingxu appeared in Song Wen's sea of consciousness.
"Master, this beast's body is a good thing, don't waste it. "Yingxu let go of the remains of the hawk-headed demon.
The black hole in the sea of ​​consciousness dropped a devouring force and swallowed the remaining body into it.
Song Wen put the Longxu Teng into the spirit beast bag again, turned around and galloped away into the distance.
...
Three days later.
